claims.label: Civil war as class war
claims.text: The 1918 conflict is described primarily as a civil war between red and white Finns.

claims.label: War of liberation wording
claims.text: The red side's fight is called a war of liberation.

claims.label: German intervention decisive
claims.text: German military intervention is presented as the decisive factor of the 1918 war.

claims.label: White terror quantified
claims.text: Executions after the 1918 war are quantified and treated as deliberate terror.

claims.label: Red leadership blamed
claims.text: The outbreak of the civil war is attributed mainly to the boldness of the Red leadership.

claims.label: War guilt on USSR
claims.text: The Continuation War is presented as a war of revenge for 1939.

claims.label: Separate war framing
claims.text: The Continuation War is framed as Finland's separate war, not part of the Second World War.

claims.label: Alliance with Germany
claims.text: Finland's co-belligerency with Nazi Germany is emphasized rather than played down.

claims.label: Mannerheim speech cited
claims.text: Mannerheim's 1941 address about advancing to Old Finland is quoted or discussed.

claims.label: Protocol divided Finland
claims.text: The secret protocol of August 1939 is presented as placing Finland in the Soviet sphere.

claims.label: Attack from world politics
claims.text: The Soviet attack of 1939 is explained first from the world-political situation.

claims.label: Mainila as pretext
claims.text: The Mainila border shelling is mentioned as the pretext for the Winter War.

claims.label: Paris treaty harsh
claims.text: The Paris treaty of 1947 is described as harsh and partly unimplemented.

claims.label: Paasikivi line accepted
claims.text: The foreign policy line after 1944 is presented as broadly accepted in Finland.
